 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day, Order
Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice S.R.Krishna Kumar
 Oral Order

In this petition, the petitioners seek the following reliefs:
a) To quash the F.I.R. bearing Crime No.133/2022 registered in the Chitradurga Women Police Station for offences punishable under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 149, 498A, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code pending before the I Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Chitradurga, in so far as the petitioners are concerned.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: b) To pass such other order, relief's or orders deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the above petition, in the interest of justice and equity.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned HCGP for respondent No.1 and learned counsel for respondent No.2 and perused the material on record.

sentences.text: 3. A perusal of the material on record will indicate that respondent No.2 - complainant is the wife of Md. Valiulla, who was arrayed as accused No.1 in Crime No.133/2022 before respondent No.1-Police.
In the said proceedings, Akhiya Jabeen Ara @ Nazeem was arrayed as accused No.6 and she is petitioner No.2 in the petition.
So also, her husband A. Vaseem @ Mohmed vasim is arrayed as accused No.5 and he is petitioner No.1 in the petition.

The dispute between respondent No.1-complainant and her husband ended in compromise vide settlement dated 15.03.2024 passed in Crl.Mis.No.24/2022 to which the petitioners are also parties and the said proceedings initiated by respondent No.2- complainant against the petitioners as well as her husband was disposed of as settled.
Under these circumstances, the question of continuing the present proceedings would not arise and the same deserves to be quashed.

4. In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The Petition is allowed.

(ii) The impugned criminal proceedings in Crime No.133/2022 registered by respondent No.1-Police, pending on the file of the I Additional Senior Civil NC:
2025:KHC:6161 Judge and JMFC, Chitraudrga, in so far as the petitioners are concerned, are hereby quashed.

Sd/-
(S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR) JUDGE BMC A Vaseem vs State By Chitradurga Women Ps on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64690817/
